tools.name: publicrecords--govcon-opportunity-feed
tools.title: Federal Contract Opportunities: SAM.gov + Grants.gov in one
tools.description:
Federal Contract Opportunities: SAM.gov + Grants.gov in one. Which federal contract opportunities were posted today? Returns SAM.gov and Grants.gov notices in one feed, new-since-last-run deltas, and source links.

When to use: Use when you need new US federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov) and grants (Grants.gov) in one feed, optionally only items new since the last run.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Allowed values: sam, grants. SAM defaults to daily Data Services CSV (samBulk=true, no key). Grants.gov needs no key.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov API key
samApiKey.description: Optional when samBulk=true. Required only for API enrich (resourceLinks) / monitor checks / samBulk=false. Personal public API key from sam.gov (Account Details → Request API Key). Free. Stored encrypted; never logged.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Names or codes, e.g. Department of Defense, DHS, EPA.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against opportunity titles.

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Two-letter US state codes for place of performance (contracts).

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Filter by notice type, e.g. solicitation, award_notice, grant_posted.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within N days
postedWithinDays.description: Only include opportunities posted within the last N days. Declared product default is **14 days** (Thursday product window).

deadlineAfter.title: Deadline after
deadlineAfter.description: Defaults to today; excludes expired opportunities.

since.title: Since date
since.description: ET calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339. Selects HF delta shards with eventDate >= since. Optional for snapshot (serves latest snapshot). For monitor, defaults to a 7-day lookback ending at the latest published delta date. Example: "2026-09-21"

includeDescriptions.title: Include full descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: When true, fetch full grant synopses (slower).

includeContacts.title: Include official contacts
includeContacts.description: When true, include SAM point-of-contact fields.

enrichTopN.title: Incumbents per opportunity (enrich mode)
enrichTopN.description: Category leaders (or predecessors) per opportunity in enrich mode.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on opportunity rows returned (and billed) after sort by postedDate desc → Sol#. Default 10000. Under the default 14d window, Active matches often exceed 10k — runs emit CAP_TRUNCATED + CAP_COVERAGE.covered/total (never silent). Cap always drops the oldest rows.

samBulk.title: Use SAM Data Services daily CSV (bulk)
samBulk.description: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility; private producer uses SAM Data Services CSV.

samEnrichLimit.title: SAM API enrich budget
samEnrichLimit.description: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility.

incumbentMode.title: Enrich join mode
incumbentMode.description: category_leaders (default): top USASpending recipients by agency×NAICS. predecessor: true prior-awardee/recompete join (stub until PREDECESSOR_JOIN.md ships). Proof schedules must keep default.

__driftFixture.description: Deliberate mismatch for the drift-check self-test.

annotations.title: Federal Contract Opportunities: SAM.gov + Grants.gov in one

tools.name: publicrecords--grants-gov-scraper
tools.title: Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines
tools.description:
Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines. Which federal grants are open right now? Searches Grants.gov and returns opportunity, agency, deadline, eligibility and the source link.

When to use: Use when you need open US federal grant opportunities from Grants.gov with agency, deadline and eligibility.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/grants-gov-scraper

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword (e.g. education, cybersecurity). Leave empty for all.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Mapped to API body agencies (e.g. HHS, EPA, NSF).

status.title: Opportunity status
status.description: Mapped to API oppStatuses. Use forecasted|posted|closed|archived or pipe-joined.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within N days
postedWithinDays.description: Server-side filter mapped to search2 dateRange (posted-date lookback). Verified values: 3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,90,180,365. Omit for no posted-date filter.

openDateFrom.title: Open date from
openDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on openDate. Accepts MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive.

closeDateFrom.title: Close date from
closeDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive. Useful for 'still open' windows.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on opportunity rows (deduped by opportunityId).

annotations.title: Grants.gov Search API: federal grants list with deadlines

tools.name: publicrecords--usaspending-awards-scraper
tools.title: USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards
tools.description:
USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards. Who won federal contracts and grants, and for how much? Pulls USAspending awards by agency, recipient, NAICS and period, with award IDs and source links.

When to use: Use when you need who won US federal contracts and grants and for how much (USAspending), by agency, recipient, NAICS or period.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Mapped to filters.keywords. Leave empty for broad recent awards; prefer agency/recipient/date.

agency.title: Awarding agency (toptier name)
agency.description: Toptier awarding agency name → filters.agencies[{type:awarding,tier:toptier,name}]. Example: Department of Defense.

recipient.title: Recipient name
recipient.description: Mapped to filters.recipient_search_text (array). Example: Boeing. Verified shape requires an array of strings.

awardTypes.title: Award type codes
awardTypes.description: Default A,B,C,D (contracts/IDVs). Avoid assistance codes that may list individuals.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today − 30 days (recent awards window).

subawards.title: Subawards mode
subawards.description: Pass subawards flag to search (default false).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on award rows (deduped by awardId|generatedInternalId).

annotations.title: USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards

tools.name: publicrecords--uk-find-a-tender-scraper
tools.title: Find a Tender & Contracts Finder: UK government tenders
tools.description:
Find a Tender & Contracts Finder: UK government tenders. Which UK government tenders were published today? Returns Find a Tender and Contracts Finder notices with buyer, value, deadline and source link.

When to use: Use when you need UK public-sector tenders from Find a Tender and Contracts Finder with buyer, value and deadline.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/uk-find-a-tender-scraper

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Case-insensitive match on tender title, description, or buyer name (client-side).

cpv.title: CPV codes
cpv.description: Match when tender.items[].classification.id starts with any code (client-side).

noticeType.title: Notice stages
noticeType.description: Mapped to API stages: planning | tender | award. Omit for all.

annotations.title: Find a Tender & Contracts Finder: UK government tenders

tools.name: publicrecords--eu-ted-notices-scraper
tools.title: TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders
tools.description:
TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders. Which EU tenders were published today? Returns TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) notices with buyer, CPV, value, deadline and source link.

When to use: Use when you need EU procurement notices from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) with buyer, CPV code, value and deadline.

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper

keywords.title: Keywords (full-text)
keywords.description: Optional. Mapped to TED expert-search FT~"…" full-text. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

expertQuery.title: Expert query (advanced)
expertQuery.description: Optional raw TED Expert Search expression. When set, overrides keywords / dates / noticeType / cpv / buyerCountry filters (you must include SORT BY yourself if desired). Example: buyer-country=DEU AND PD>=20260101 SORT BY publication-date DESC

publicationDateFrom.title: Publication date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
publicationDateFrom.description: Optional. Default: 14 days ago. Converted to TED PD>=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

publicationDateTo.title: Publication date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
publicationDateTo.description: Optional. Converted to TED PD<=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

noticeType.title: Notice type
noticeType.description: Optional eForms notice-type filter (e.g. cn-standard, can-standard, pin-only, pin-cfc-standard). Ignored if expertQuery is set.

cpv.title: CPV code
cpv.description: Optional Common Procurement Vocabulary code (e.g. 72000000). Mapped to classification-cpv. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

buyerCountry.title: Buyer country (ISO3)
buyerCountry.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 buyer country (e.g. DEU, FRA, NLD). Mapped to buyer-country. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

scope.title: Search scope
scope.description: TED scope: ALL (archive) or ACTIVE (currently open). Default ALL.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum notice rows to push to the default dataset.

annotations.title: TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders

tools.name: publicrecords--legistar-meetings-scraper
tools.title: Legistar City Council Minutes & Agendas: meetings, items
tools.description:
Legistar City Council Minutes & Agendas: meetings, items. What did a city council decide? Returns Legistar meetings, agenda items, votes and documents for any city on Legistar, with the source link.

When to use: Use when you need city council or county board meetings, agenda items, votes and documents from a Legistar client (e.g. 'seattle', 'chicago').

Returns: the run's dataset rows as structured JSON (one row per result), plus the run and dataset IDs for paging the full dataset.

Behavior: starts one run of the Apify Actor "publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper" through Apify's hosted MCP gateway (mcp.apify.com) with your own APIFY_TOKEN; the run uses your Apify account. Read-only: it only reads public web data and changes nothing on the source site. Docs: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

clients.title: Client slugs
clients.description: Legistar client codes. Use the hostname label of {slug}.legistar.com. Working examples: seattle, milwaukee, madison, oakland, sanjose, boston, denver, columbus.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD (EventDate / MatterIntroDate). Default: 30 days ago.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on dataset rows (events + matters combined).

resource.title: Resource
resource.description: Which Legistar collection to pull. Options: events = Meetings (events); matters = Matters (legislation); both = Both.

includeEventItems.title: Include agenda item titles
includeEventItems.description: Extra HTTP call per event. Titles flattened into eventItemTitles (pipe-separated). Default off.

annotations.title: Legistar City Council Minutes & Agendas: meetings, items
